document.about: Google 2024 Environmental Report. Page 37 maps carbon-free energy by grid region, each region's name and share set bold beside it.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#151): a bold line at the body size was a heading whatever followed it. Bold lines in a run with nothing between them, a name over a role at the end or a chart's labels, opened sections that held nothing.

checks.issue: Each region on the map (`U.S. (CAISO) 55%`, `Netherlands 80%`) was a section holding nothing.
